validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + SPEC: found and read the actual Guangxi DRC approval document on the issuing agency's own site (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn, doc 桂发改油气〔2022〕640号, dated 2022-06-10/published 2022-06-15; also reprinted by 北极星 bjx.com.cn the next day, same text) for '桂东北天然气环网桂林-阳朔-荔浦段天然气管道项目' (Northeast-Guilin gas ring network Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu section pipeline project). It states VERBATIM: route start '广西液化天然气外输管道桂林站' (Guangxi LNG external transport pipeline's Guilin Station) end '荔浦输气站' (Lipu gas station); route entirely within 临桂区/阳朔县/荔浦市 (Lingui District / Yangshuo County / Lipu City, all in Guilin prefecture, Guangxi); length '管道全长约106公里' (~106 km); design pressure 6.3 MPa; diameter 'D406.4毫米' (406.4 mm); steel grade L360; design capacity '8.4×10^8立方米/年' = 0.84 bcm/y; total investment '58485万元' = RMB 584,850,000; project unit (operator/owner) '国家管网集团西南油气管道有限责任公司南宁输油气分公司'. EVERY ONE of these matches the GEM row's recorded LengthKnown (106.00 km), Diameter (406.40 mm), Capacity (0.84 bcm/y), SegmentCost (584850000.00 RMB), StartLocation/EndLocation, and Operator/Owner almost exactly (see attribution caveat below) -- this is about as strong a confirmation as a single-document primary source can give, and the row is REAL, correctly located and correctly classified as a gas transmission branch line (6.3 MPa transmission-grade pressure, not a gathering/process line). No duplicate: checked the full 43-PID Guangxi roster and nothing else names Yangshuo or Lipu or matches this corridor/spec combination -- P4726 (Guilin Distribution Station, Lingui District, shelved) is a different, unrelated Guilin-area branch. HOWEVER: the approval is dated 2022-06 (成文日期 2022年06月10日, 批复 issued 2022-06-15), not October -- GEM's ProposalMonth=10 does not match; I could not find any dated document naming an October 2022 milestone for this project (the underlying municipal request 市发改报〔2022〕196号 is undated in the text I could access). Recommend correcting ProposalMonth to 06, keeping ProposalYear=2022.

validity.researcher_notes: The 2022-06 DRC approval (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn, same doc as above) names the project unit as '国家管网集团西南油气管道有限责任公司南宁输油气分公司' (PipeChina Southwest OIL AND GAS Pipeline Co Ltd, Nanning Oil and Gas Transport Branch) -- GEM's Operator/QCCOwner field reads '国家管网集团西南管道有限责任公司南宁输油气分公司', omitting '油气' from '西南管道'. Same entity, just an abbreviated company name in GEM; not flagging as wrong, just noting the fuller official form for a future correction. Separately, the approval text says the project 'expands the Guangxi LNG external transport pipeline's Guilin Station AND the China-Myanmar pipeline's Guilin gas station' (扩建广西液化天然气外输管道桂林站、中缅管道桂林输气站) as its two upstream tie-ins -- i.e. gas can be sourced from BOTH the Guangxi LNG Terminal Transport Pipeline network and the China-Myanmar pipeline. GEM's FuelSource field records only 'Guangxi LNG Terminal Transport Pipeline, Liuzhou-Guilin Branch' -- a specific sub-segment name I could not find named anywhere else (not in the 43-PID roster, not elsewhere in the sourced text), and it silently drops the China-Myanmar connection. Not calling this a hard error since the general LNG-network linkage is genuinely supported, but it is incomplete/unverified in its specific form.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's own recorded Status source is the 2024-04-18 dnr.gxzf.gov.cn land-use approval for the project's Lipu section (the row's current_ref) -- but that document is actually evidence AGAINST 'proposed': it is a land-expropriation approval, the second-to-last step before physical construction, issued nearly two years after the June 2022 project approval. Independent corroboration: (1) a Liuzhou municipal government investment-promotion-bureau article (tzcjj.liuzhou.gov.cn, published 2023-04-07) listing Guangxi's 2023 annual energy-project investment plan explicitly names '桂东北天然气环网桂林—阳朔—荔浦段天然气管道项目' as one of 11 '续建' (continuing/carry-over CONSTRUCTION) projects under '油气及煤炭储运项目' -- i.e. by April 2023 the project was already classed as under construction, not merely proposed; (2) a SECOND, separate dnr.gxzf.gov.cn land-use approval (2024-01-29, doc 桂政土批函〔2024〕10号) for the project's 临桂 (Lingui) section, confirming staged land acquisition continuing into 2024; (3) the original June 2022 DRC project approval (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn) as the baseline. Together these are 3 distinct government-agency documents (Guangxi DRC 2022, Liuzhou city govt 2023, Guangxi Natural Resources Dept x2 in 2024) independently confirming the project moved from approved (2022-06) to active/continuing construction (by 2023) with rolling land acquisition through segments in 2024. I could not find a more specific construction-START month/date, so ConstructionYear=2023 is the earliest year I can defensibly source (the true start could be anywhere from mid-2022 to early 2023); I did not find any 2025/2026 completion or commissioning announcement for this specific Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu segment (distinct from the already-operating, larger-diameter 'Guilin branch' referenced elsewhere on the wiki page, e.g. P4487), so I am not proposing 'operating'.

summary: Real, correctly-classified project (桂东北天然气环网桂林-阳朔-荔浦段, verified verbatim against the issuing Guangxi DRC's own approval posting: length/diameter/capacity/cost/operator/endpoints all match exactly); flagged ProposalMonth (10->06) as a spec error, minor attribution caveats on Operator's full legal name and FuelSource's unverified branch qualifier, and staged a status change from proposed to construction (2023) backed by 3 independent government documents (2022 approval, 2023 provincial investment plan, 2024 land approvals).
